intro: Colombia has Andes mountains, Amazon rainforest, Caribbean beaches and Pacific jungle, and is one of the most biodiverse countries on Earth.

chapters.title: Mountains, plains and jungle
text: The Andes split into three ranges running north to south, with the Magdalena River between them. The Llanos are vast eastern grasslands, and the Amazon covers the south-east. The Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta is the world's highest coastal mountain range.

chapters.title: Biodiversity
text: Colombia has more bird species than any other country. Caño Cristales is called the 'river of five colours' for its red water plants.
